acceptance: The verb prints success and false-diagnosis rates with Wilson bounds per tier (red first)
fix: A read-only verb reads the decisions ledger and the repair records and prints both rates with Wilson intervals per tier.
summary: Spec section 20.2: the flip to enforce needs repair success at or above 70 percent and false diagnosis at or below 30 percent, as Wilson intervals. No verb reports them.
title: Self-healing X16h: a verb that measures repair success and false diagnosis for the operator flip
